# GLOUCESTER CITY COUNCIL

### Monday, October 5, 2026 - 6:00 p.m.

## AGENDA
**Individual items from committee reports may be consolidated into a consent agenda**

1. CC#2026-018 (Gross): Amend Ch. 2 "Administration," Art. 2 "City Council," Sec. 28 "Fees" by DELETING "and published in a local newspaper whenever fee changes or new fees are approved by the City Council."

### COMMITTEE
Chair, Councilor Sean Nolan
Vice Chair, Frank Margiotta
Councilor Marjorie Grace

CC: Mayor Paul Lundberg; Kelly Dolan; Grace E. Poirier; Suzanne P. Egan

*The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the Chair which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law*
headline: Amend Chapter 2 fee-notice rule by deleting newspaper publication requirement for fee changes, CC#2026-018 (Gross).
summary: The committee will consider CC#2026-018, a proposal from Gross to amend Chapter 2, Article 2, Section 28 of the city code. The change would delete the requirement that fee changes or new fees be published in a local newspaper when approved by the City Council.
